description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the Public Utilities Commission exercising its statutory powers to issue Certificates of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply. This falls squarely under legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory compliance.
